# Third-party source

This directory contains vendored research implementations needed by local
experiments. Each project keeps its original README and license.

- `spatialscaper/`: local copy of
  [iranroman/SpatialScaper](https://github.com/iranroman/SpatialScaper), used
  directly by `scripts/render_distance_foa.py`.
The exact upstream revision of the existing copy was not recorded when it was
downloaded. Record a commit hash or release tag here before the next vendor
update so future changes can be audited.
